title: Publish persisted CheckIn evidence refs through backend Bus triggers
verify: Bus publication occurs only after persistence
Published events include refs, scope, trust/freshness labels, and redaction status
UI Feed/admin text/raw chat/secrets cannot enter Bus or agent context
evidence_required: BusEventEnvelope contract and redaction test output
constraints: Publisher is backend/domain adapter, not direct model response
Timeline refs may be included as audit/export refs but cannot be replayed as current authority
Malformed or duplicate publication attempts are rejected or idempotently ignored
invariants: Agent-originated domain output and working events pass through project-owned publication boundaries
UI Feed is presentation-only and never agent working context
Secrets and unauthorized Plant/Farm data are forbidden Bus content
